axes.blender: armature space, mm, right-handed, Z up
axes.unreal: component space, cm, left-handed (Blender y flipped), Z up

charging_handle.motion: translate -X 0..67.9; at full travel rotate about X 0..+15 deg (lock)

trigger.motion: rotate about Y (+ = pull: lower end rearward)

mag_release.motion: rotate about Y (- = release: lower end forward, nose rearward)

magazine.motion: attach only, no weighted vertices; head = Mag socket

lod_note: import LOD1-3 with SkeletalMeshEditorSubsystem.import_lod (same skeleton, same root; no bones removed). The sizes are the LOD-pop gate's switch distances at the SK's engine radius (bind box + bounds extension). First-person components force LOD0 (ForcedLodModel = 1)
notifies_note: FBX carries no notifies: the Unreal harness adds them at these frames (U9). ReloadEmpty starts with the bolt held open (starts_at_rest false); StockFold ends folded and StockUnfold starts folded. Clips that move the bolt hold the selector at AUTO (45 deg); blend the player's fire mode from A_SMG01_Selector per bone

import.bone_compression_why: rigid parts: ACL cracked rigid parts by ~1.1 mm on the fan (gun study 4.10.9); U9 gates <= 0.1 mm

bounds_extension_cm.why: LOD0-3 posed at every frame of every clip (the folded stock: StockFold / StockUnfold; the folded sights: SightFlip) vs LOD0's bind AABB (Unreal's stored bounds), per axis (+1 mm where it grows; Unreal axes: y flipped): the mesh's Positive/Negative Bounds Extension. The attached magazine is its own component with its own bounds

physics_proxies.how: import the proxy onto SK_SMG01_Skeleton with Create Physics Asset ON (one 250 mm cube on 'body'), rewrite the body from physics_bodies, rename it PHYS_SMG01, assign it to SK_SMG01, delete the proxy mesh

elements.covers: receiver (upper, housing, end block, top rail, bolt, handle, selector)
barrel + muzzle device ahead of the receiver face
bounds envelope: the mesh's extended bounds (bind AABB + bounds extension, both stock states); no collision, no mass (the component's physics-route bounds, W5 U7)

physics_bodies.role: ONE rigid body on 'body' (every other bone is its child): Kinematic while held (NoCollision / QueryOnly in hand), simulated when dropped; a folded SK keeps the extended stock shapes (Q14, U7 reports a folded drop); the last box is the bounds envelope (no collision, no mass), so the component's bounds hold both stock states and keep the 37.54 cm LOD radius; the seated magazine is its own component with collision off while attached

sockets.name: Grip
sockets.use: origin; attach to the character's weapon_r. 46 mm down the grip axis from the web line (plan / AR-01 H1 value); H1 early confirms or moves it and the sidecar records hand_offset

sockets.name: SupportHand
sockets.use: hand_l two-bone IK target: off-hand palm on the magwell front (study 5.3 SMG default); PROVISIONAL until H1 (may move to the lower rail)

sockets.name: Trigger
sockets.use: index finger target

sockets.name: Muzzle
sockets.use: flash, smoke, tracer; on the bore within 0.5 mm / 0.05 deg

sockets.name: MuzzleSeat
sockets.use: suppressor / device seat

sockets.name: Sight
sockets.use: ADS: aperture centre, +X toward the front post tip (sight line parallel to the bore)

sockets.name: SightFront
sockets.use: front post tip (folded-state check, review camera)

sockets.name: Mag
sockets.use: SM_SMG01_Mag attaches with zero relative transform; +Z up the insertion axis (tilted with the 8.27 deg rake), +X forward

sockets.name: MagInsertStart
sockets.use: straight reload path start: Mag moved 68.2 mm along its -Z (insert depth 58.2 + 10)

sockets.name: ShellEject
sockets.use: casing spawn; +X = throw: to the right, 15 deg forward of square, 10 deg up (real blowback ports throw right and slightly forward). Stock folded: the throw cone meets the folded stock (B3b: 29 stock / pad vertices inside it; Q5 open), so spawned casings ignore the gun's own collision (W4 tech review)

sockets.name: ChargingHandle
sockets.use: hand target (knob centre)

sockets.name: Selector
sockets.use: thumb target: left lever tab, 4 mm in from the tip

sockets.name: MagRelease
sockets.use: finger target: the paddle's rear face 6 mm above its bottom (the trigger finger pushes it forward)

sockets.name: Rail_Top
sockets.use: attachments: slot 0 centre (rearmost cut slot, under the rear sight's lug) on the rail-top plane, +X along the slots, +Z up; mounts snap at k x 10.01

sockets.name: Rail_Bottom
sockets.use: lower rail slot 0 centre, +X along the slots, +Z out of the rail (down)

sockets.name: Stock
sockets.use: modular stocks: the receiver's rear (hinge) face

sockets.name: Shoulder
sockets.use: TP aim offsets; butt-pad centre, +X = pad normal reversed; follows the fold

sockets.name: SlingFront
sockets.use: sling: the front-left eyelet hole on the receiver front face (3/4 view)

sockets.name: SlingRear
sockets.use: sling: the lower through-hole of the stock's rear upright (axis Y)

sockets.name: CenterOfMass
sockets.use: physics CoM (stock extended, mag out); the folded CoM is reported in the sidecar

sockets.name: Holster
sockets.use: = CenterOfMass until the game sets it

magazine.attach: zero relative transform (SnapToTarget) on the Mag socket; straight reload path MagInsertStart -> (lerp along the magazine's -Z, rotation constant) -> Mag

M_SMG01_Furniture.user_control: Colour (recolour group SMG01, default the shipped black)

materials._source: smg_spec.json materials.slots (the slot table, not a literal)

hand_offset.frame: hand_r bone (MH_PlayerDefault metahuman_base_skel, Blender armature axes)
hand_offset.note: U11 reproduces it in engine (Grip on a socket of hand_r at this offset)

abp_angle_table.rule: the shared ABP drives 0..1 / detent index; this table maps to angles (U2b)

gun.texel_class_rule: spec bands = targets; shipped class medians up to 1.25 x the band top (W2 B9, spec R44); measured medians in texel_classes_measured_px_per_cm
gun.first_person: FP_Weapon + TP_Weapon (SK_SMG01) and FP_Mag + TP_Mag (SM_SMG01_Mag on Mag); every FP component FirstPersonPrimitiveType = FirstPerson and ForcedLodModel = 1
